description: Typical risks to people for each screening criterion, with usual measures and the GDPR articles that apply. Used when the assistant is not available and as a check on its answer. Likelihood and severity are starting points for the privacy officer (1 low to 5 high).

evaluation_scoring.title: People are profiled or scored in ways they cannot see or challenge
evaluation_scoring.mitigation: Document the logic, keep a person in the loop for effects on individuals, give a way to contest results and review accuracy regularly.
evaluation_scoring.query: profiling and automated individual decision making

automated_decisions.title: Automated decisions significantly affect people without meaningful human review
automated_decisions.mitigation: Add human review before an adverse decision, explain the decision on request and test for errors and bias.
automated_decisions.query: automated individual decision making including profiling

systematic_monitoring.title: Continuous monitoring or tracking intrudes on private life
systematic_monitoring.mitigation: Limit what is recorded to what is needed, shorten retention, anonymise or aggregate where possible and tell people clearly what is monitored.
systematic_monitoring.query: systematic monitoring of a publicly accessible area on a large scale

sensitive_data.title: Disclosure or misuse of special category or highly personal data harms people seriously
sensitive_data.mitigation: Record the Article 9 condition, restrict access to those who need it, encrypt at rest and in transit, log access and review it.
sensitive_data.query: processing of special categories of personal data

large_scale.title: A breach or error affects very many people
large_scale.mitigation: Minimise the data held, segment access, keep tested backups and an incident plan, and set and enforce retention limits.

combining_datasets.title: Combining data from different sources reveals more than people expect
combining_datasets.mitigation: Document each source and purpose, check compatibility with the original purpose and tell people about the enrichment.

vulnerable_subjects.title: People who cannot freely refuse or object are affected, and consent is not freely given
vulnerable_subjects.mitigation: Do not rely on consent where there is an imbalance of power, offer clear information and a contact for questions, and involve representatives where appropriate.
vulnerable_subjects.query: conditions for consent freely given imbalance

innovative_technology.title: New technology has consequences for privacy that are not yet understood
innovative_technology.mitigation: Pilot on a small scale, test for accuracy and bias, apply data protection by design and review after launch.
innovative_technology.query: data protection by design and by default

prevents_exercise_of_rights.title: The outcome decides whether someone can use a service or exercise a right
prevents_exercise_of_rights.mitigation: Provide a clear route to challenge the outcome, review decisions and keep records of how they were reached.
prevents_exercise_of_rights.query: transparent information and facilitating the exercise of data subject rights

transfer_gap.title: Personal data is sent outside the EEA without a recorded safeguard
transfer_gap.mitigation: Put standard contractual clauses or another Article 46 mechanism in place, complete a transfer assessment, or stop the transfer.

agreement_gap.title: A processor handles data without a written agreement
agreement_gap.mitigation: Sign an Article 28 data processing agreement and record it before further processing.
agreement_gap.query: processor contract binding on the processor
